name: 武陆逊

skills.name: 雄幕
skills.text: 每轮开始时，你可以将手牌摸至体力上限，然后将任意张牌随机置入牌堆，从牌堆或弃牌堆中获得等量的点数为8的牌，这些牌不计入你的手牌上限。你每回合受到第一次伤害时，若你的手牌数小于等于体力值，此伤害-1。

skills.name: 彰才
skills.text: 你使用或打出点数为8的牌时，可以摸X张牌（X为手牌中剩余点数为8的牌数量且至少为1）。

skills.name: 儒贤
skills.text: 限定技，出牌阶段，你可令“彰才”改为所有点数均可触发摸牌直到你的下回合开始。

currentVersusFormal: The current official hero and complete formal launch agree on all three skills. Formal Zhangcai says 牌数; current hero says 牌数量. No semantic difference.
engineeringInterpretations: Xiongmu selects any current Hand/Equipment originals, including the equipped Wooden Ox but excluding its grain. Actual equipment-loss, health and grain-spill children complete before further choices.

Each actual inserted original is placed using the native deterministic RNG at a uniform current-deck insertion position. The unselected deck retains its relative order; this does not shuffle the preexisting deck.

Obtain min(actual originals inserted, available rank-eight originals), searching current DrawPile top first and then current Discard order. This is obtain, not draw; no reshuffle or cloned replacements. An inserted eight can be obtained back.

The obtained exact-entity Hand-limit exemption belongs permanently to the original recipient. It applies whenever that recipient holds the entity in Hand, survives loss/regrant, does not follow transfers to others, and applies again on return.

Positive actual damage to the recipient occupies the first-damage slot for the real actual turn even before skill acquisition or when Hand>Hp. External prevention to zero is not damage received. An actual Xiongmu reduction consumes its own first-damage right even when it reduces the damage to zero.

Zhangcai captures the actual accepted Use/Played effective rank and remaining-Hand effective rank-eight count at its native action boundary, after excluding real Hand costs. Each logical accepted action contributes one trigger; response Use and pure Played remain distinct native actions.

Ruxian widens only Zhangcai trigger ranks, keeping its explicitly defined X as remaining rank-eight Hand count, minimum one. Its issued effect lasts until the next actual owner turn starts, including face-down skips; it is not confined to the current Play phase.

An issued native draw/obtain continues through real payment/replacement/health/movement children with its frozen original invoice; new voluntary choices require a living authorized owner. No forged sources, new Uses or repeated payments are introduced.

Ruxian removes the rank-eight trigger restriction from real native accepted actions. A genuine zero-material virtual Use/Played retains its native absent/zero rank and can trigger while Ruxian is active; it is never relabeled rank eight. The primary sources do not separately rule on absent ranks.

Ruxian uses the existing game-scope owner/skill/activation usage ledger. Reacquisition does not reset it. No new generic limited-skill-reset capability or invented reset fixture is introduced; the current Bao2025 reset producer is restricted to its original trigger contract and cannot target Ruxian.

secondaryOperatorGuide.summary: Equipment is selectable for Xiongmu. Its Ruxian analysis describes remaining same-rank cards and an own-Play-only duration, differing from the complete printed-skill contract; this guide is not treated as a formal rule replacement.

sourceHierarchyAndDifferences: Current hero and dated formal publication have complete same three rules. 彰才 difference 牌数量/牌数 is not semantic.

The implemented contract follows the current official hero and formal launch: Ruxian removes the trigger-rank restriction while X remains the explicitly defined remaining rank-eight Hand count, minimum one.
